mapper.select: SELECT pti.VSL_TAG_DSC as fac_name, pti.PWQ_TAG as fac_code FROM TB_PEAK_TAG_INF pti WHERE pti.CLSFC = #{zone_name} AND pti.IS_ALL = '0'

WITH raw_data AS ( SELECT rd.tagname, rd.ts, rd.value, pti.CLSFC, pti.PWI_UNIT_VALUE, LAG(rd.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.tagname ORDER BY rd.ts) AS prev_ts, LAG(rd.value) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.tagname ORDER BY rd.ts) AS prev_value FROM TB_RAWDATA rd JOIN TB_PEAK_TAG_INF pti ON rd.tagname = pti.PWI_TAG WHERE pti.MNTR_YN = '1' AND pti.IS_ALL = '1' AND pti.CLSFC IS NOT NULL AND pti.CLSFC != ''
AND rd.ts >= DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{start_date},' 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND rd.ts <= concat(#{end_date},' 23:59:59')
AND rd.ts >= DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{start_date},'-01 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND rd.ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-31 23:59:59')
AND rd.ts >= DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{start_date},'-01-01 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND rd.ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-12-31 23:59:59')
), base_diff AS ( SELECT tagname, ts, CLSFC, CASE WHEN RIGHT(tagname, 3) = 'IKW' THEN ROUND(value * PWI_UNIT_VALUE, 6) WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR prev_value IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN value < prev_value THEN 0 WHEN (value - prev_value) > 2000 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((value - prev_value) * PWI_UNIT_VALUE, 6) END AS raw_y FROM raw_data ), filled_diff AS ( SELECT tagname, ts, CLSFC, raw_y, COUNT(raw_y) OVER (PARTITION BY tagname ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS grp FROM base_diff ), diff_data AS ( SELECT tagname, ts, CLSFC, COALESCE(raw_y, MAX(raw_y) OVER (PARTITION BY tagname, grp)) AS y FROM filled_diff ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ts,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') DATE_FORMAT(ts,'%Y-%m-%d') DATE_FORMAT(ts,'%Y-%m') DATE_FORMAT(ts,'%Y') AS x, CLSFC AS zone_code, ROUND(SUM(y), 2) AS y FROM diff_data WHERE 1 = 1
AND ts >= concat(#{start_date},' 00:00:00') AND ts <= concat(#{end_date},' 23:59:59')
AND ts >= concat(#{start_date},'-01 00:00:00') AND ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-31 23:59:59')
AND ts >= concat(#{start_date},'-01-01 00:00:00') AND ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-12-31 23:59:59')
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ts,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') DATE(ts) DATE_FORMAT(ts,'%Y-%m') DATE_FORMAT(ts,'%Y'), CLSFC ORDER BY zone_code, x

WITH raw_data AS ( SELECT rd.tagname, rd.ts, rd.value, pti.CLSFC, pti.PWI_UNIT_VALUE, LAG(rd.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.tagname ORDER BY rd.ts) AS prev_ts, LAG(rd.value) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.tagname ORDER BY rd.ts) AS prev_value FROM TB_RAWDATA rd JOIN TB_PEAK_TAG_INF pti ON rd.tagname = pti.PWI_TAG WHERE pti.MNTR_YN = '1' AND pti.IS_ALL = '1' AND pti.CLSFC IS NOT NULL AND pti.CLSFC != ''
AND rd.ts >= DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{start_date},' 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND rd.ts <= concat(#{end_date},' 23:59:59')
AND rd.ts >= DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{start_date},'-01 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND rd.ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-31 23:59:59')
AND rd.ts >= DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{start_date},'-01-01 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND rd.ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-12-31 23:59:59')
), base_diff AS ( SELECT tagname, ts, CLSFC, CASE WHEN RIGHT(tagname, 3) = 'IKW' THEN ROUND(value * PWI_UNIT_VALUE, 6) WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR prev_value IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN value < prev_value THEN 0 WHEN (value - prev_value) > 2000 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((value - prev_value) * PWI_UNIT_VALUE, 6) END AS raw_y FROM raw_data ), filled_diff AS ( SELECT tagname, ts, CLSFC, raw_y, COUNT(raw_y) OVER (PARTITION BY tagname ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS grp FROM base_diff ), diff_data AS ( SELECT tagname, ts, CLSFC, COALESCE(raw_y, MAX(raw_y) OVER (PARTITION BY tagname, grp)) AS y FROM filled_diff ) SELECT CLSFC AS zone_code, ROUND(SUM(y), 2) AS y FROM diff_data WHERE 1 = 1
AND ts >= concat(#{start_date},' 00:00:00') AND ts <= concat(#{end_date},' 23:59:59')
AND ts >= concat(#{start_date},'-01 00:00:00') AND ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-31 23:59:59')
AND ts >= concat(#{start_date},'-01-01 00:00:00') AND ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-12-31 23:59:59')
GROUP BY CLSFC ORDER BY CLSFC

WITH raw_data AS ( SELECT rd.tagname, rd.ts, rd.value, pti.PWI_UNIT_VALUE, LAG(rd.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.tagname ORDER BY rd.ts) AS prev_ts, LAG(rd.value) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.tagname ORDER BY rd.ts) AS prev_value FROM TB_RAWDATA rd JOIN TB_PEAK_TAG_INF pti ON rd.tagname = pti.PWI_TAG WHERE pti.IS_ALL = '1' AND pti.MNTR_YN = '1'
AND rd.ts >= DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{start_date},' 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND rd.ts <= concat(#{end_date},' 23:59:59')
AND rd.ts >= DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{start_date},'-01 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND rd.ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-31 23:59:59')
AND rd.ts >= DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{start_date},'-01-01 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND rd.ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-12-31 23:59:59')
), base_diff AS ( SELECT tagname, ts, CASE WHEN RIGHT(tagname, 3) = 'IKW' THEN ROUND(value * PWI_UNIT_VALUE, 6) WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR prev_value IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN value < prev_value THEN 0 WHEN (value - prev_value) > 2000 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((value - prev_value) * PWI_UNIT_VALUE, 6) END AS raw_y FROM raw_data ), filled_diff AS ( SELECT tagname, ts, raw_y, COUNT(raw_y) OVER (PARTITION BY tagname ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS grp FROM base_diff ), diff_data AS ( SELECT tagname, ts, COALESCE(raw_y, MAX(raw_y) OVER (PARTITION BY tagname, grp)) AS y FROM filled_diff ) SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(y), 0), 2) AS all_pwq FROM diff_data WHERE 1 = 1
AND ts >= concat(#{start_date},' 00:00:00') AND ts <= concat(#{end_date},' 23:59:59')
AND ts >= concat(#{start_date},'-01 00:00:00') AND ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-31 23:59:59')
AND ts >= concat(#{start_date},'-01-01 00:00:00') AND ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-12-31 23:59:59')

WITH raw_data AS ( SELECT rd.tagname, rd.ts, rd.value, pti.CLSFC, pti.PWI_UNIT_VALUE, LAG(rd.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.tagname ORDER BY rd.ts) AS prev_ts, LAG(rd.value) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.tagname ORDER BY rd.ts) AS prev_value FROM TB_RAWDATA rd JOIN TB_PEAK_TAG_INF pti ON rd.tagname = pti.PWI_TAG WHERE pti.MNTR_YN = '1' AND pti.IS_ALL = '1' AND pti.CLSFC IS NOT NULL AND pti.CLSFC != '' AND rd.ts > DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -1 DAY) AND rd.ts <= NOW() ), base_diff AS ( SELECT tagname, ts, CLSFC, CASE WHEN RIGHT(tagname, 3) = 'IKW' THEN ROUND(value * PWI_UNIT_VALUE, 6) WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR prev_value IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN value < prev_value THEN 0 WHEN (value - prev_value) > 2000 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((value - prev_value) * PWI_UNIT_VALUE, 6) END AS raw_y FROM raw_data ), filled_diff AS ( SELECT tagname, ts, CLSFC, raw_y, COUNT(raw_y) OVER (PARTITION BY tagname ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS grp FROM base_diff ), diff_data AS ( SELECT tagname, ts, CLSFC, COALESCE(raw_y, MAX(raw_y) OVER (PARTITION BY tagname, grp)) AS y FROM filled_diff ), latest_ts AS ( SELECT MAX(ts) AS max_ts FROM diff_data WHERE ts > DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -15 MINUTE) AND ts <= NOW() ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.ts, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS x, ROUND(SUM(d.y), 2) AS y, d.CLSFC AS zone_name FROM diff_data d JOIN latest_ts l ON d.ts = l.max_ts GROUP BY d.CLSFC, d.ts ORDER BY d.CLSFC

SELECT fac_name, fac_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN y != 0 THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN y != 0 THEN y END), 2) ELSE 0 END AS y FROM ( SELECT fc.FAC_NAME, fc.FAC_CODE, rdh.VALUE*pti.PWQ_UNIT_VALUE AS y FROM TB_RAWDATA_HOUR_INGRT rdh, TB_TAGINFO ti, TB_FAC fc, TB_PEAK_TAG_INF pti WHERE rdh.tagname = ti.tagname and ti.fac_code = fc.FAC_CODE AND pti.PWQ_TAG = ti.tagname AND ti.USE_YN = '1' and pti.mntr_yn = '1' and ti.USE_YN ='1' and
rdh.ts >=concat(#{start_date},' 00:00:00') AND rdh.ts <= concat(#{end_date},' 23:59:00')
rdh.ts >=concat(#{start_date},'-01 00:00:00') AND rdh.ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-31 23:59:00')
rdh.ts >=concat(#{start_date},'-01-01 00:00:00') AND rdh.ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-12-31 23:59:00')
and ti.zone_code = #{zone_code} and fc.fac_code = #{fac_code} ) a GROUP BY fac_name

SELECT a.*, ( select CONCAT(PUMP_GRP_NM, PUMP_GRP_IDX) from TB_CTR_PRF_PUMPMST_INF where PMB_TAG PRI_D_TAG PWI_TAG SPI_TAG = tagname limit 1 ) name FROM ( select DATE_FORMAT(b.ts,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') DATE_FORMAT(b.ts,'%Y-%m-%d') DATE_FORMAT(b.ts,'%Y-%m') DATE_FORMAT(b.ts,'%Y') ts, b.tagname, ROUND(b.value * c.PWI_UNIT_VALUE, 2) as value b.value as value from TB_RAWDATA_HOUR b , TB_PEAK_TAG_INF c where
b.ts >= CONCAT(#{start_date}, ' 00:00:00') AND b.ts <= CONCAT(#{end_date}, ' 23:59:00')
b.ts >= CONCAT(#{start_date}, '-01 00:00:00') AND b.ts <= CONCAT(#{end_date}, '-31 23:59:00')
b.ts >= CONCAT(#{start_date}, '-01-01 00:00:00') AND b.ts <= CONCAT(#{end_date}, '-12-31 23:59:00')
and b.tagname IN ( select PMB_TAG PWI_TAG PRI_D_TAG SPI_TAG from TB_CTR_PRF_PUMPMST_INF )
and b.tagname = c.PWI_TAG and c.CLSFC = '송수동' and c.IS_ALL = '0'
group by b.ts DATE(b.ts) MONTH(b.ts) YEAR(b.ts), b.tagname ) a;

SELECT a.*, '정읍가압장 펌프' as name FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ts,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') DATE_FORMAT(ts,'%Y-%m-%d') DATE_FORMAT(ts,'%Y-%m') DATE_FORMAT(ts,'%Y') ts, tagname, value FROM TB_RAWDATA_HOUR b WHERE
ts >=concat(#{start_date},' 00:00:00') AND ts <= concat(#{end_date},' 23:59:00')
ts >=concat(#{start_date},'-01 00:00:00') AND ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-31 23:59:00')
ts >=concat(#{start_date},'-01-01 00:00:00') AND ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-12-31 23:59:00')
AND tagname IN (SELECT PWI_TAG FROM TB_CTR_PRF_PUMPMST_INF) a group by b.ts date(b.ts) month(b.ts) year(b.ts),b.tagname )

SELECT fc.fac_code, fc.fac_name, fc.DSC as DCS, ti.tagname FROM TB_TAGINFO ti , TB_FAC fc, TB_PEAK_TAG_INF tpti where ti.fac_code = fc.FAC_CODE AND ti.USE_YN = '1' AND fc.USE_YN = '1' AND tpti.MNTR_YN = '1' AND ti.TAGNAME = tpti.PWQ_TAG AND ti.zone_code = #{zone_code} GROUP BY ti.fac_code

WITH raw_data AS ( SELECT rdm.tagname, rdm.ts, rdm.value, LAG(rdm.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY rdm.tagname ORDER BY rdm.ts) AS prev_ts, LAG(rdm.value) OVER (PARTITION BY rdm.tagname ORDER BY rdm.ts) AS prev_value FROM TB_RAWDATA_HOUR rdm JOIN TB_PEAK_TAG_INF pti ON rdm.tagname = pti.PWQ_TAG WHERE pti.IS_ALL = '0' AND pti.mntr_yn = '1'
AND pti.CLSFC = #{zone_code}
AND rdm.ts >= DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{start_date},' 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND rdm.ts <= concat(#{end_date},' 23:59:59')
AND rdm.ts >= DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{start_date},'-01 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND rdm.ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-31 23:59:59')
AND rdm.ts >= DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{start_date},'-01-01 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND rdm.ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-12-31 23:59:59')
), diff_data AS ( SELECT ts, tagname, CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR prev_value IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN value < prev_value THEN 0 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, prev_ts, ts) > 0 THEN (value - prev_value) / TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, prev_ts, ts) ELSE (value - prev_value) END AS diff_val FROM raw_data ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(dd.ts,'%Y-%m-%d %H') DATE_FORMAT(dd.ts,'%Y-%m-%d') DATE_FORMAT(dd.ts,'%Y-%m') DATE_FORMAT(dd.ts,'%Y') AS x, pti.clsfc AS zone_code, fc.fac_name, dd.tagname, fc.fac_code, fc.dcs as dcs, pti.pwq_unit, ROUND(AVG(dd.diff_val * pti.PWQ_UNIT_VALUE), 2) AS y FROM diff_data dd JOIN TB_PEAK_TAG_INF pti ON dd.tagname = pti.PWQ_TAG JOIN TB_FAC fc ON fc.FAC_NAME = pti.HMI_TAG_DSC WHERE 1 = 1
AND dd.ts >= concat(#{start_date},' 00:00:00') AND dd.ts <= concat(#{end_date},' 23:59:00')
AND dd.ts >= concat(#{start_date},'-01 00:00:00') AND dd.ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-31 23:59:00')
AND dd.ts >= concat(#{start_date},'-01-01 00:00:00') AND dd.ts <= concat(#{end_date},'-12-31 23:59:00')
AND pti.CLSFC = #{zone_code}
GROUP BY x, zone_code, fc.fac_name, dd.tagname, fc.FAC_CODE, fc.DSC, pti.PWQ_UNIT ORDER BY dd.tagname, x

WITH raw_data AS ( SELECT rd.tagname, rd.ts, rd.value, pti.PWI_UNIT_VALUE, LAG(rd.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.tagname ORDER BY rd.ts) AS prev_ts, LAG(rd.value) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.tagname ORDER BY rd.ts) AS prev_value FROM TB_RAWDATA rd JOIN TB_PEAK_TAG_INF pti ON rd.tagname = pti.PWI_TAG WHERE pti.MNTR_YN = '1' AND pti.IS_ALL = '1' AND rd.ts >= DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND rd.ts <= now() ), base_diff AS ( SELECT tagname, ts, CASE WHEN RIGHT(tagname, 3) = 'IKW' THEN ROUND(value * PWI_UNIT_VALUE, 6) WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR prev_value IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN value < prev_value THEN 0 WHEN (value - prev_value) > 2000 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((value - prev_value) * PWI_UNIT_VALUE, 6) END AS raw_y FROM raw_data ), filled_diff AS ( SELECT tagname, ts, raw_y, COUNT(raw_y) OVER (PARTITION BY tagname ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS grp FROM base_diff ), diff_data AS ( SELECT tagname, ts, COALESCE(raw_y, MAX(raw_y) OVER (PARTITION BY tagname, grp)) AS y FROM filled_diff ) SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(y), 2), 0) AS nowPwi, DATE_FORMAT(ts, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS ts FROM diff_data WHERE ts >= DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AND ts <= now() GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ts, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT 1m 'month1', 2m 'month2', 3m 'month3', 4m 'month4', 5m 'month5', 6m 'month6', 7m 'month7', 8m 'month8', 9m 'month9', 10m 'month10', 11m 'month11', 12m 'month12' FROM TB_GOALSETTING WHERE YEAR=DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y')

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROUND(sum(rdh.VALUE*pti.PWQ_UNIT_VALUE),2) AS todayPwr FROM TB_RAWDATA_HOUR_INGRT rdh, TB_PEAK_TAG_INF pti WHERE rdh.tagname = pti.PWQ_TAG and pti.mntr_yn = '1' and pti.IS_ALL ='1' and DATE(rdh.ts) = DATE(CURDATE()) ) todayPwr, ( SELECT ROUND(sum(rdh.VALUE*pti.PWQ_UNIT_VALUE),2) AS afterPwr FROM TB_RAWDATA_HOUR_INGRT rdh, TB_PEAK_TAG_INF pti WHERE rdh.tagname = pti.PWQ_TAG and pti.mntr_yn = '1' and pti.IS_ALL ='1' and DATE(rdh.ts) = DATE(CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) afterPwr, ( SELECT ROUND(sum(rdh.VALUE*pti.PWQ_UNIT_VALUE),2) AS monthPwr FROM TB_RAWDATA_HOUR_INGRT rdh, TB_PEAK_TAG_INF pti WHERE rdh.tagname = pti.PWQ_TAG and pti.IS_ALL ='1' and pti.mntr_yn = '1' and DATE(ts) BETWEEN DATE(LAST_DAY(NOW() - INTERVAL 1 MONTH) + INTERVAL 1 DAY) and LAST_DAY(NOW()) ) monthPwr, ( SELECT ROUND(sum(rdh.VALUE*pti.PWQ_UNIT_VALUE),2) AS yearPwr FROM TB_RAWDATA_HOUR_INGRT rdh, TB_PEAK_TAG_INF pti WHERE rdh.tagname = pti.PWQ_TAG and pti.IS_ALL ='1' and pti.mntr_yn = '1' and DATE(ts) BETWEEN DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(NOW()), '-01-01')) and DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(NOW()), '-12-31')) ) yearPwr

SELECT date, TYPE, COALESCE(ROUND(savingCost,2),0) as savingCost, COALESCE(ROUND(savingKwh,2), 0) as savingKwh, COALESCE(ROUND(savingCo2,2), 0) as savingCo2 FROM TB_RST_SAVINGS_TARGET WHERE date >= LAST_DAY(NOW() - interval 1 month) AND date <= LAST_DAY(NOW()) ORDER BY date

SELECT substring(date,1,4) as date, TYPE, REPLACE(format(sum(savingCost),0),',','') AS savingCost, REPLACE(format(sum(savingKwh),0),',','') AS savingKwh, REPLACE(format(sum(savingCo2),0),',','') AS savingCo2 FROM TB_RST_SAVINGS_TARGET GROUP BY SUBSTRING(date,1,4) ORDER BY date

SELECT MNTH, STN_TM, RATE_IDX, SSN, TIMEZONE, FORMAT (BASE_RATE,0) BASE_RATE, ELCTR_RATE FROM TB_RT_RATE_INF WHERE RATE_IDX IN (1,2,3) AND MNTH = #{mnth} ORDER BY RATE_IDX, MNTH, CAST(STN_TM AS UNSIGNED)

select ti.zone_code, fc.FAC_NAME, DATE_FORMAT(rd.ts,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') AS ts, COALESCE(ROUND(rd.value*pti.PWI_UNIT_VALUE, 2), 0) AS 'kWVALUE' FROM TB_RAWDATA rd, TB_PEAK_TAG_INF pti, TB_TAGINFO ti, TB_FAC fc WHERE rd.tagname = pti.PWI_TAG AND ti.fac_code = fc.FAC_CODE AND ti.tagname = pti.PWI_TAG and pti.mntr_yn = '1' AND ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AND ts <= NOW() AND fc.USE_YN='1' GROUP BY fc.FAC_NAME ORDER BY kWVALUE+0 DESC LIMIT 6

select DATE_FORMAT(rd.ts,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') AS ts, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(rd.value)*pti.PWI_UNIT_VALUE, 2), 0) AS 'kWVALUE' FROM TB_RAWDATA rd, TB_PEAK_TAG_INF pti WHERE rd.tagname = pti.PWI_TAG AND pti.MNTR_YN ='1' AND pti.IS_ALL='1' and rd.value != 0 AND ts >= (NOW() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AND ts <= NOW() GROUP by rd.ts ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT PWI_TAG FROM TB_PEAK_TAG_INF WHERE CLSFC = #{clsfc} AND IS_ALL = #{is_all} AND MNTR_YN = #{mntr_yn} AND PWI_TAG IS NOT NULL AND PWI_TAG != '' ORDER BY PWI_TAG
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(PEAK_VALUE), 10000) AS goalPeak FROM TB_MONTHLY_PEAK WHERE YM = #{ym}

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(MAX(CAST(PEAK_MAX_VALUE AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0), 0) AS pwiUnitValue FROM tb_peak_data_hour WHERE ts >= CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m'), '01000000') AS DATETIME) - INTERVAL 11 MONTH AND ts < CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m'), '01000000') AS DATETIME) + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AND value >= 7000

WITH ranked_prediction AS ( SELECT ANLY_TIME, CNFRM_TIME, PRDCT_PWR, PEAK_YN, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, NOW(), ANLY_TIME) AS remainMinutes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ANLY_TIME ORDER BY CNFRM_TIME DESC ) AS rn FROM TB_PEAK_PWR_PRDCT_RST WHERE ANLY_TIME > NOW() ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ANLY_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS anlyTime, DATE_FORMAT(CNFRM_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS cnfrmTime, ROUND(PRDCT_PWR, 2) AS prdctPwr, PEAK_YN AS peakYn, remainMinutes FROM ranked_prediction WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY ANLY_TIME ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(TS, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS TS, ROUND(VALUE, 2) AS VALUE FROM TB_RAWDATA WHERE TAGNAME = #{tagName} AND TS >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND TS <= NOW() ORDER BY TS ASC
